The '''Deluvia system''' was located in the [[Klina sector/Legends|Klina sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the creatures known as [[Deluvian fatworm]]s.<ref name="KOTOR" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Deluvia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square S-13.<ref name="EAOC" />
